SND_EN_PJP_PJPHEAD PJP
         INNER JOIN SND_EN_OP1_OTH_BSEN_PHS_LVL1 PP1
                    ON PJP.PORG_ORGACODE = PP1.PORG_ORGACODE
                        AND PJP.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = PP1.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE
                        AND PJP.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE = PP1.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE
         INNER JOIN SND_EN_PP2_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL2 DSR
                         ON DSR.PORG_ORGACODE = PJP.PORG_ORGACODE_PHS_LVL2_F
                             AND DSR.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = PJP.PBET_BUSENT_TYPE_PHS_LVL2_F
                             AND DSR.EPP2_BUSENT_PHS_LVL2_CODE = PJP.EPP2_BUSENT_CODE_PHS_LVL2_F
         INNER join snd_pr_dst_dsrtype DSRTYPE
                         ON DSR.porg_orgacode = DSRTYPE.porg_orgacode
                         and DSR.pdst_dsr_type = DSRTYPE.pdst_dsr_type
         LEFT OUTER JOIN SND_EN_PP2_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL2_M DSRM
                         ON DSR.PORG_ORGACODE = DSRM.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND DSR.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = DSRM.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE
                             AND DSR.epp2_busent_phs_lvl2_code = DSRM.epp2_busent_phs_lvl2_code
                             AND DSRM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT OUTER JOIN GLB_PR_BNK_BANK BNK
                         ON BNK.PORG_ORGACODE = PJP.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND BNK.PBNK_BANK_CODE = PJP.PBNK_BANK_CODE
         LEFT OUTER JOIN GLB_PR_BNK_BANK_M BNKM
                         ON BNK.PORG_ORGACODE = BNKM.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND BNK.PBNK_BANK_CODE = BNKM.PBNK_BANK_CODE
                             AND BNKM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT OUTER JOIN GLB_PR_BNB_BANKBRANCH BNB
                         ON BNB.PORG_ORGACODE = PJP.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND BNB.PBNK_BANK_CODE = PJP.PBNK_BANK_CODE
                             AND BNB.PBNB_BNBR_CODE = PJP.PBNB_BNBR_CODE
         LEFT OUTER JOIN GLB_PR_BNB_BANKBRANCH_M BNBM
                         ON BNB.PORG_ORGACODE = BNBM.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND BNB.PBNK_BANK_CODE = BNBM.PBNK_BANK_CODE
                             AND BNB.PBNB_BNBR_CODE = BNBM.PBNB_BNBR_CODE
                             AND BNBM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT OUTER JOIN SND_EN_PJP_PJPHEAD_M PJPM
                         ON PJP.PORG_ORGACODE = PJPM.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND PJP.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = PJPM.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE
                             AND PJP.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE = PJPM.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE
                             AND PJP.EPJP_PJPNO = PJPM.EPJP_PJPNO
                             AND PJPM.PLNG_LANGCODE = '@Session(languageCode)'

SND_EN_PJP_PJPHEAD PJP
         INNER JOIN SND_EN_OP1_OTH_BSEN_PHS_LVL1 PP1
                    ON PJP.PORG_ORGACODE = PP1.PORG_ORGACODE
                        AND PJP.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = PP1.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE
                        AND PJP.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE = PP1.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE
         INNER JOIN SND_EN_PP2_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL2 DSR
                         ON DSR.PORG_ORGACODE = PJP.PORG_ORGACODE_PHS_LVL2_F
                             AND DSR.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = PJP.PBET_BUSENT_TYPE_PHS_LVL2_F
                             AND DSR.EPP2_BUSENT_PHS_LVL2_CODE = PJP.EPP2_BUSENT_CODE_PHS_LVL2_F
         INNER join snd_pr_dst_dsrtype DSRTYPE
                         ON DSR.porg_orgacode = DSRTYPE.porg_orgacode
                         and DSR.pdst_dsr_type = DSRTYPE.pdst_dsr_type
         LEFT OUTER JOIN SND_EN_PP2_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL2_M DSRM
                         ON DSR.PORG_ORGACODE = DSRM.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND DSR.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = DSRM.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE
                             AND DSR.epp2_busent_phs_lvl2_code = DSRM.epp2_busent_phs_lvl2_code
                             AND DSRM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT OUTER JOIN GLB_PR_BNK_BANK BNK
                         ON BNK.PORG_ORGACODE = PJP.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND BNK.PBNK_BANK_CODE = PJP.PBNK_BANK_CODE
         LEFT OUTER JOIN GLB_PR_BNK_BANK_M BNKM
                         ON BNK.PORG_ORGACODE = BNKM.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND BNK.PBNK_BANK_CODE = BNKM.PBNK_BANK_CODE
                             AND BNKM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT OUTER JOIN GLB_PR_BNB_BANKBRANCH BNB
                         ON BNB.PORG_ORGACODE = PJP.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND BNB.PBNK_BANK_CODE = PJP.PBNK_BANK_CODE
                             AND BNB.PBNB_BNBR_CODE = PJP.PBNB_BNBR_CODE
         LEFT OUTER JOIN GLB_PR_BNB_BANKBRANCH_M BNBM
                         ON BNB.PORG_ORGACODE = BNBM.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND BNB.PBNK_BANK_CODE = BNBM.PBNK_BANK_CODE
                             AND BNB.PBNB_BNBR_CODE = BNBM.PBNB_BNBR_CODE
                             AND BNBM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'

result.tbl:
(select cmm.tcmm_docno,
        cmm.pdot_docmtype,
        coalesce(pdotm.pdot_desc, pdot.pdot_desc)                                                   pdot_desc,
        coalesce(DOSM.pdos_desc, DOS.pdos_desc)                                                     DOCUMENT_STATUS,
        cmm.PEXS_EXECUTION_STATUS,
        ES.PEXS_DESC,
        coalesce(pp1m.epp1_desc, pp1.epp1_desc)                                                     epp1_descx,
        cmm.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c                                                          as Outlet_Code,
        coalesce(pp1mu.epp1_desc, pp1u.epp1_desc)                                                   epp1_descy,
        CMM.EPJP_PJPNO_DAILY                                                                     as PJP_NO,
        coalesce(pp1dsrm.epp2_desc, pp1dsr.epp2_desc)                                               epp2_desc_OB,
        coalesce(pp1DSRm_DM.epp2_desc, pp1DSR_DM.epp2_desc)                                         epp2_desc_DM,
        CMM.EPJP_PJPNO_DAILY || ' / ' || epjp_pjpno_daily_delivery                               AS PJP_ORDBKR_DELMAN,
        coalesce(pp1dsrm.epp2_desc, pp1dsr.epp2_desc) || ' ' || '/' || ' ' ||
        coalesce(pp1DSRm_DM.epp2_desc, pp1DSR_DM.epp2_desc)                                      as ORDBKR_DELMAN,
        cmm.epl1_busent_code_log_lvl1_l                                                          AS SECTION_CODE,
        coalesce(SECTM.epl1_desc, SECT.epl1_desc)                                                as SECTION_NAME,
        coalesce(pp1mu.epp1_abrv, pp1u.epp1_abrv)                                                   epp1_abrvy,
        cmm.pcur_currcode,
        cmm.tcmm_docm_date                                                                          tcmm_docm_fromdate,
        cmm.tcmm_docm_date                                                                          tcmm_docm_todate,
        cmm.tcmm_delivery_date,
        cmm.porg_orgacode,
        coalesce(cmd.gross_amt_fcy, 0)                                                              gross_amt_fcy,
        coalesce(cmd.tcmc_value, 0)                                                                 tax_amt_fcy,
        coalesce(cmd.discAmt, 0)                                                                    dsc_amt_fcy,
        coalesce(CMM.tcmm_received_amt_fcy, 0)                                                   as RECEIVED_AMT_FCY,
        cmm.tcmm_net_amt_fcy                                                                        net_amount,
        cmm.pbet_busentity_type,
        cmm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
        cmt.pcmt_cashmemo_type,
        coalesce(cmtm.pcmt_desc, cmt.pcmt_desc)                                                     cashmemoTypeDesc,
        cmm.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_c,
        cmm.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_c,
        cmm.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c,
        cmm.tcmm_ref_docno,
        cmm.tcmm_ref_no,
        GNM.tcmr_refdocno                                                                        as GIN_NO,
        CMM.MODIFIED_DATE                                                                        as MODIFIED_DATE,
        CMM.tcmm_docm_date_time::time                                                            as ORDER_TIME,
        CMM.CREATE_DATE                                                                          AS CREATE_DATE,
        dsn.tdsn_refdocno                                                                        AS txt__invoicenumber,
        dsn.tdsn_document_date                                                                   as txt__invoicedate,
        coalesce(cmd.markupAmt, 0)                                                               AS MARKUP,
        (coalesce(cmd.gross_amt_fcy, 0) + coalesce(cmd.markupAmt, 0) + coalesce(cmd.discAmt, 0)) AS NIV,
        CMM.tcmm_actual_delivery_time                                                            AS tcmm_actual_delivery_time
 from snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_master cmm
          inner join (select porg_orgacode,
                             pbet_busentity_type,
                             epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
                             pdot_docmtype,
                             tcmm_docno,
                             sum(gross_amt_fcy) gross_amt_fcy,
                             sum(tcmc_value)    tcmc_value,
                             sum(discAmt)       discAmt,
                             sum(markupAmt)     markupAmt
                      from (select sum(coalesce(cmd.tcmd_grs_amt_fcy, 0)) gross_amt_fcy,
                                   0                                      tcmc_value,
                                   0                                      discAmt,
                                   0                                      markupAmt,
                                   cmd.porg_orgacode,
                                   cmd.pbet_busentity_type,
                                   cmd.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
                                   cmd.pdot_docmtype,
                                   cmd.tcmm_docno
                            from snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_detail cmd
                            group by cmd.porg_orgacode, cmd.pbet_busentity_type, cmd.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
                                     cmd.pdot_docmtype, cmd.tcmm_docno
                            union all
                            select 0                            gross_amt_fcy,
                                   sum(coalesce(tcmc_value, 0)) tcmc_value,
                                   0                            discAmt,
                                   0                            markupAmt,
                                   porg_orgacode,
                                   pbet_busentity_type,
                                   epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
                                   pdot_docmtype,
                                   tcmm_docno
                            from snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_charges charg
                            where charg.tcmc_promotion_type = 'SCHTAX'
                            group by porg_orgacode, pbet_busentity_type, epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code, pdot_docmtype,
                                     tcmm_docno
                            union all
                            select 0                            gross_amt_fcy,
                                   0                            tcmc_value,
                                   0                            discAmt,
                                   sum(coalesce(tcmc_value, 0)) markupAmt,
                                   porg_orgacode,
                                   pbet_busentity_type,
                                   epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
                                   pdot_docmtype,
                                   tcmm_docno
                            from snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_charges charg
                            where charg.tcmc_promotion_type = 'SCHCHARGE'
                            group by porg_orgacode, pbet_busentity_type, epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code, pdot_docmtype,
                                     tcmm_docno
                            union all
                            select 0                                       gross_amt_fcy,
                                   0                                       tcmc_value,
                                   sum(coalesce(disc.tcmo_dsc_amt_fcy, 0)) discAmt,
                                   0                                       markupAmt,
                                   disc.porg_orgacode,
                                   disc.pbet_busentity_type,
                                   disc.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
                                   disc.pdot_docmtype,
                                   disc.tcmm_docno
                            from snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_offering disc
                                     inner join snd_pr_trn_trans_nature natr
                                                on disc.porg_orgacode = natr.porg_orgacode and
                                                   disc.ptrn_tran_nature = natr.ptrn_tran_nature and
                                                   natr.ptrn_nature = 'DIS'
                            group by disc.porg_orgacode, disc.pbet_busentity_type, disc.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
                                     disc.pdot_docmtype, disc.tcmm_docno) dt
                      group by porg_orgacode, pbet_busentity_type, epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code, pdot_docmtype,
                               tcmm_docno) cmd
                     on cmm.porg_orgacode = cmd.porg_orgacode and cmm.pbet_busentity_type = cmd.pbet_busentity_type and
                        cmm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = cmd.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code and
                        cmm.pdot_docmtype = cmd.pdot_docmtype and cmm.tcmm_docno = cmd.tcmm_docno
          inner join snd_pr_dot_documenttype pdot
                     on cmm.porg_orgacode = pdot.porg_orgacode and cmm.pdot_docmtype = pdot.pdot_docmtype
          left join SND_PR_DOS_DOCUMENTSTATUS DOS
                    on cmm.porg_orgacode = DOS.porg_orgacode and cmm.pdot_docmtype = DOS.pdot_docmtype and
                       cmm.pdos_docmstatus = DOS.pdos_docmstatus
          left join SND_PR_DOS_DOCUMENTSTATUS_M DOSM
                    on cmm.porg_orgacode = DOSM.porg_orgacode and cmm.pdot_docmtype = DOSM.pdot_docmtype AND
                       cmm.pdos_docmstatus = DOSM.pdos_docmstatus AND DOSM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
          inner join glb_pr_exs_execution_status ES
                     on ES.porg_orgacode = cmm.porg_orgacode and ES.pdot_docmtype = cmm.pdot_docmtype and
                        ES.PEXS_EXECUTION_STATUS = cmm.PEXS_EXECUTION_STATUS
          inner join glb_pr_cmt_cashmemo_type cmt
                     on cmm.porg_orgacode = cmt.porg_orgacode and cmm.pcmt_cashmemo_type = cmt.pcmt_cashmemo_type
          inner join snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1 pp1 on cmm.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_a = pp1.porg_orgacode and
                                                         cmm.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_a = pp1.pbet_busentity_type and
                                                         cmm.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_a = pp1.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
          inner join snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1 pp1U on cmm.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_c = pp1u.porg_orgacode and
                                                          cmm.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_c = pp1u.pbet_busentity_type and
                                                          cmm.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c = pp1u.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
          inner join snd_en_pp2_prf_bsen_phs_lvl2 pp1DSR on cmm.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl2_f = pp1dsr.porg_orgacode and
                                                            cmm.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl2_f = pp1dsr.pbet_busentity_type and
                                                            cmm.epp2_busent_code_phs_lvl2_f = pp1dsr.epp2_busent_phs_lvl2_code
          inner join snd_en_pp2_prf_bsen_phs_lvl2 pp1DSR_DM
                     on cmm.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl2_h = pp1DSR_DM.porg_orgacode and
                        cmm.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl2_h = pp1DSR_DM.pbet_busentity_type and
                        cmm.epp2_busent_code_phs_lvl2_h = pp1DSR_DM.epp2_busent_phs_lvl2_code
          left join snd_pr_dot_documenttype_m pdotm
                    on pdot.porg_orgacode = pdotm.porg_orgacode and pdot.pdot_docmtype = pdotm.pdot_docmtype and
                       pdotm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
          left join glb_pr_cmt_cashmemo_type_m cmtm
                    on cmt.porg_orgacode = cmtm.porg_orgacode and cmt.pcmt_cashmemo_type = cmtm.pcmt_cashmemo_type and
                       cmtm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
          left join snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1_m pp1m
                    on pp1.porg_orgacode = pp1m.porg_orgacode and pp1.pbet_busentity_type = pp1m.pbet_busentity_type and
                       pp1.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = pp1m.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code and
                       pp1m.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
          left join snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1_m pp1mU on pp1u.porg_orgacode = pp1mu.porg_orgacode and
                                                            pp1u.pbet_busentity_type = pp1mu.pbet_busentity_type and
                                                            pp1u.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = pp1mu.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code and
                                                            pp1mu.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
          left join snd_en_pp2_prf_bsen_phs_lvl2_m pp1DSRm on pp1dsr.porg_orgacode = pp1dsrm.porg_orgacode and
                                                              pp1dsr.pbet_busentity_type = pp1dsrm.pbet_busentity_type and
                                                              pp1dsr.epp2_busent_phs_lvl2_code = pp1dsrm.epp2_busent_phs_lvl2_code and
                                                              pp1dsrm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
          left join snd_en_pp2_prf_bsen_phs_lvl2_m pp1DSRm_DM on pp1DSR_DM.porg_orgacode = pp1DSRm_DM.porg_orgacode and
                                                                 pp1DSR_DM.pbet_busentity_type = pp1DSRm_DM.pbet_busentity_type and
                                                                 pp1DSR_DM.epp2_busent_phs_lvl2_code =
                                                                 pp1DSRm_DM.epp2_busent_phs_lvl2_code and
                                                                 pp1DSRm_DM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
          left join snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_refinfo GNM
                    on cmm.PORG_ORGACODE = GNM.PORG_ORGACODE and cmm.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = GNM.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE and
                       cmm.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE = GNM.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE and
                       cmm.PDOT_DOCMTYPE = GNM.PDOT_DOCMTYPE and cmm.TCMM_DOCNO = GNM.TCMM_DOCNO and
                       GNM.tcmr_refdoctype = 'GN-01' and GNM. tcmr_status='1'
          LEFT join snd_en_pl1_prf_bsen_log_lvl1 SECT on cmm.porg_orgacode_log_lvl1_l = SECT.porg_orgacode and
                                                         cmm.pbet_busent_type_log_lvl1_l = SECT.pbet_busentity_type and
                                                         cmm.epl1_busent_code_log_lvl1_l = SECT.epl1_busent_log_lvl1_code
          left join snd_en_pl1_prf_bsen_log_lvl1_M SECTM on SECT.porg_orgacode = SECTM.porg_orgacode and
                                                            SECT.pbet_busentity_type = SECTM.pbet_busentity_type and
                                                            SECT.epl1_busent_log_lvl1_code = SECTM.epl1_busent_log_lvl1_code and
                                                            SECTM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
          LEFT JOIN snd_tr_dsn_doc_sequence_no dsn
                    ON dsn.porg_orgacode = cmm.porg_orgacode AND dsn.pbet_busentity_type = cmm.pbet_busentity_type AND
                       dsn.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = cmm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code AND dsn.pdot_docmtype = case
                                                                                                                 when CMM.PDOT_DOCMTYPE IN ('CM-02', 'CM-04', 'CM-07')
                                                                                                                     then cmm.pdot_docmtype_ref
                                                                                                                 else cmm.pdot_docmtype end AND
                       dsn.tdsn_docno = case
                                            when CMM.PDOT_DOCMTYPE IN ('CM-02', 'CM-04', 'CM-07')
                                                then cmm.tcmm_ref_docno
                                            else cmm.tcmm_docno end
 Order by CMM.CREATE_DATE desc)
cmm

(SELECT cd.PORG_ORGACODE,
        cd.pbet_busentity_type,
        cd.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
        cd.PDOT_DOCMTYPE,
        cd.TCMM_DOCNO,
        cd.TCMD_SRNO,
        cd.pprd_prodcode,
        CONCAT(cd.pprd_prodcode, ' - ', COALESCE(prdms.pprd_desc,prdm.pprd_desc, prd.pprd_desc), ' - ',
               cd.tcmd_retail_price)                                                                           AS TXT__PPRDDESC,
        cd.PBTH_BATCH,
        stm.PSTT_DESC,
        cd.TCMD_RATE,
        COALESCE(cd.TCMD_QTY_C_1, 0)                                                                           AS TCMD_QTY_C_1,
        COALESCE(cd.TCMD_QTY_C_2, 0)                                                                           AS TCMD_QTY_C_2,
        COALESCE(cd.TCMD_QTY_C_3, 0)                                                                           AS TCMD_QTY_C_3,
        COALESCE(cd.TCMD_GRS_AMT_FCY, 0)                                                                       AS TCMD_GRS_AMT_FCY,
        COALESCE(cd.TCMD_DSC_AMT_FCY, 0)                                                                       AS TCMD_DSC_AMT_FCY,
        COALESCE(cd.TCMD_TAX_AMT_FCY, 0)                                                                       AS TCMD_TAX_AMT_FCY,
        (COALESCE(cd.TCMD_GRS_AMT_FCY, 0) + COALESCE(cd.TCMD_DSC_AMT_FCY, 0) +
         COALESCE(cd.TCMD_TAX_AMT_FCY, 0))                                                                        TXT__NET_AMOUNT,
        COALESCE(cd.TCMD_QTY_B_1, 0)                                                                           AS TCMD_QTY_B_1,
        COALESCE(cd.TCMD_QTY_B_2, 0)                                                                           AS TCMD_QTY_B_2,
        COALESCE(cd.TCMD_QTY_B_3, 0)                                                                           AS TCMD_QTY_B_3,
        COALESCE(cd.tcmd_qty_1, 0)                                                                             AS ORDER_CS,
        COALESCE(cd.tcmd_qty_2, 0)                                                                             AS ORDER_SU,
        COALESCE(cd.tcmd_qty_3, 0)                                                                             AS ORDER_PC,
        cd.epjp_pjpno_daily,
        coalesce(RNTM.PRNT_DESC, RNT.PRNT_DESC)                                                                as PRNT_DESC,
        cd.tcmd_comments,
        cd.MODIFIED_DATE                                                                                       AS MODIFIED_DATE,
        coalesce(charges.schtax, 0)                                                                            as tax,
        coalesce(charges.schcharge, 0)                                                                         as markup,
        (coalesce(cd.tcmd_grs_amt_fcy, 0) + coalesce(cd.tcmd_dsc_amt_fcy, 0) + coalesce(charges.schtax, 0) +
         coalesce(charges.schcharge, 0))                                                                       as netAmount,
        (COALESCE(cd.TCMD_GRS_AMT_FCY, 0) + coalesce(charges.schcharge, 0) + COALESCE(cd.TCMD_DSC_AMT_FCY, 0)) AS NIV
 FROM SND_TR_CMM_CASHMEMO_DETAIL cd
          INNER JOIN snd_pr_prd_product prd
                     ON cd.porg_orgacode = prd.porg_orgacode AND cd.porp_princode = prd.porp_princode AND
                        cd.pprd_prodcode = prd.pprd_prodcode
          LEFT JOIN snd_pr_prd_product_m prdm
                    ON prd.porg_orgacode = prdm.porg_orgacode AND prd.porp_princode = prdm.porp_princode AND
                       prd.pprd_prodcode = prdm.pprd_prodcode AND prdm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
               LEFT JOIN snd_pr_prd_product_m prdms
                    ON prd.porg_orgacode = prdms.porg_orgacode AND prd.porp_princode = prdms.porp_princode AND
                       prd.pprd_prodcode = prdms.pprd_prodcode AND prdms.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCodeSecondary)'
          INNER JOIN snd_pr_stt_sku_stocktype st
                     ON cd.porg_orgacode = st.porg_orgacode AND cd.pstt_stock_type = st.pstt_stock_type
          LEFT JOIN snd_pr_stt_sku_stocktype_m stm
                    ON st.porg_orgacode = stm.porg_orgacode AND st.pstt_stock_type = stm.pstt_stock_type AND
                       stm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
          inner join snd_pr_bth_prod_batch bat
                     ON bat.porg_orgacode = cd.porg_orgacode AND bat.porp_princode = cd.porp_princode AND
                        bat.pprd_prodcode = cd.pprd_prodcode and bat.pbth_batch = cd.pbth_batch
          LEFT JOIN GLB_PR_RNT_REASON_TYPE RNT
                    ON RNT.PORG_ORGACODE = cd.PORG_ORGACODE AND RNT.PRNT_REASON_TYPE = cd.PRNT_REASON_TYPE_SALE_RETURN
          LEFT JOIN GLB_PR_RNT_REASON_TYPE_M RNTM
                    ON RNT.PORG_ORGACODE = RNTM.PORG_ORGACODE AND RNT.PRNT_REASON_TYPE = RNTM.PRNT_REASON_TYPE AND
                       RNTM.PLNG_LANGCODE = '@Session(languageCode)'
          left outer join (select chrgd.porg_orgacode,
                                  chrgd.pbet_busentity_type,
                                  chrgd.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
                                  chrgd.pdot_docmtype,
                                  chrgd.tcmm_docno,
                                  chrgd.porp_princode,
                                  chrgd.pprd_prodcode,
                                  sum(coalesce(case
                                                   when chrg.tcmc_promotion_type = 'SCHTAX' then tccd_charges_amount_fcy
                                                   else 0 end, 0)) as schtax,
                                  sum(coalesce(case
                                                   when chrg.tcmc_promotion_type = 'SCHCHARGE'
                                                       then tccd_charges_amount_fcy
                                                   else 0 end, 0)) as schcharge
                           from snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_chrgs_dt chrgd
                                    inner join snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_charges chrg

SND_TR_CMM_CASHMEMO_OFFRITEM CFI
         inner join snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_offering offr
                    on cfi.porg_orgacode = offr.porg_orgacode and cfi.pbet_busentity_type = offr.pbet_busentity_type and
                       cfi.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = offr.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code and
                       cfi.pdot_docmtype = offr.pdot_docmtype and cfi.tcmm_docno = offr.tcmm_docno and
                       cfi.tcmo_offer_srno = offr.tcmo_offer_srno
         INNER JOIN SND_TR_CMM_CASHMEMO_DETAIL CMD
                    ON CMD.porg_orgacode = CFI.porg_orgacode AND CMD.pbet_busentity_type = CFI.pbet_busentity_type AND
                       CMD.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = CFI.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code AND
                       CMD.pdot_docmtype = CFI.pdot_docmtype AND CMD.tcmm_docno = CFI.tcmm_docno AND
                       CMD.porp_princode = CFI.porp_princode AND CMD.pprd_prodcode = CFI.pprd_prodcode AND
                       CMD.pbth_batch = CFI.pbth_batch
         inner join prm_pm_pms_promotion_setup prmtype
                    on offr.porg_orgacode = prmtype.porg_orgacode and offr.psch_schme_id = prmtype.ppms_promotion_code
         left join prm_pm_pms_promotion_setup_m prmtypem on prmtype.porg_orgacode = prmtypem.porg_orgacode and
                                                            prmtype.ppms_promotion_code = prmtypem.ppms_promotion_code and
                                                            prmtypem.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         INNER JOIN snd_pr_prd_product PRD
                    ON CFI.porg_orgacode = PRD.porg_orgacode AND CFI.porp_princode = PRD.porp_princode AND
                       CFI.pprd_prodcode = PRD.pprd_prodcode
         LEFT JOIN snd_pr_prd_product_m PRDM
                   ON PRD.porg_orgacode = PRDM.porg_orgacode AND PRD.porp_princode = PRDM.porp_princode AND
                      PRD.pprd_prodcode = PRDM.pprd_prodcode AND PRDM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT JOIN snd_pr_prd_product_m PRDMS
                   ON PRD.porg_orgacode = PRDMS.porg_orgacode AND PRD.porp_princode = PRDMS.porp_princode AND
                      PRD.pprd_prodcode = PRDMS.pprd_prodcode AND PRDMS.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCodeSecondary)'
         inner join snd_pr_trn_trans_nature nat
                    on cfi.porg_orgacode = nat.porg_orgacode and cfi.ptrn_tran_nature = nat.ptrn_tran_nature and
                       nat.ptrn_nature = 'DIS'

        CFI.pbet_busentity_type,
        CFI.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE,
        CFI.PDOT_DOCMTYPE,
        CFI.TCMM_DOCNO,
        SUM(ofitm.tcmi_dsc_amt_fcy)                                                 AS TCMO_DSC_AMT_FCY,
        SUM(ofitm.tcmi_tax_amt_fcy)                                                 AS TCMO_TAX_AMT_FCY,
        CFI.MODIFIED_DATE                                                           AS MODIFIED_DATE,
        PPS.PPMS_REFERENCE_CODE                                                     AS PPMS_REFERENCE_CODE,
        PPS.PPSC_PROMOTION_SECTYPE                                                  AS ppsc_promotion_sectype,

        SUM((coalesce(ofitm.TCMI_QTY_1, 0) * coalesce(bth.pbth_uom_factor_1, 0)) +
            (coalesce(ofitm.TCMI_QTY_2, 0) * coalesce(bth.pbth_uom_factor_2, 0)) +
            (coalesce(ofitm.TCMI_QTY_3, 0) * coalesce(bth.pbth_uom_factor_3, 0)))   as freeQty,

        SUM((coalesce(ofitm.TCMI_QTY_B_1, 0) * coalesce(bth.pbth_uom_factor_1, 0)) +
            (coalesce(ofitm.TCMI_QTY_B_2, 0) * coalesce(bth.pbth_uom_factor_2, 0)) +
            (coalesce(ofitm.TCMI_QTY_B_3, 0) * coalesce(bth.pbth_uom_factor_3, 0))) as allocatedQty

 FROM snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_offering CFI
          INNER JOIN prm_pm_pms_promotion_setup PPS
                     ON CFI.porg_orgacode = PPS.porg_orgacode AND CFI.psch_schme_id = PPS.ppms_promotion_code

          inner join snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_offritem ofitm
                     on ofitm.porg_orgacode = cfi.porg_orgacode
                         and ofitm.pbet_busentity_type = cfi.pbet_busentity_type
                         and ofitm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = cfi.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
                         and ofitm.pdot_docmtype = cfi.pdot_docmtype
                         and ofitm.tcmm_docno = cfi.tcmm_docno
                         and ofitm.tcmo_offer_srno = cfi.tcmo_offer_srno
          left join snd_pr_bth_prod_batch bth
                    on CFI.porg_orgacode = bth.porg_orgacode
                        and ofitm.porp_princode = bth.porp_princode
                        and ofitm.pprd_prodcode = bth.pprd_prodcode
                        and ofitm.pbth_batch = bth.pbth_batch

 GROUP BY CFI.PORG_ORGACODE, CFI.TCMM_DOCNO, CFI.PDOT_DOCMTYPE, CFI.psch_schme_id, PPS.PPMS_DESC,
          CFI.tcmo_promotion_type, CFI.pbet_busentity_type, CFI.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE, CFI.MODIFIED_DATE,
          PPS.PPMS_REFERENCE_CODE, PPS.PPSC_PROMOTION_SECTYPE)

snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_payment cp
INNER JOIN snd_tr_fdh_financial_doc_hdr fd
    ON cp.porg_orgacode = fd.porg_orgacode
       AND cp.pbet_busentity_type = fd.pbet_busentity_type
       AND cp.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = fd.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
       AND cp.pdot_docmtype_ref = fd.pdot_docmtype

inner join snd_pr_dot_documenttype dt on dt.porg_orgacode =fd.porg_orgacode  and dt.pdot_docmtype =fd.pdot_docmtype

(SELECT CFI.PORG_ORGACODE                                                                 AS PORG_ORGACODE,
             CFI.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE                                                           AS PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE,
             CFI.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE                                                     AS EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE,
             CFI.PDOT_DOCMTYPE                                                                 AS PDOT_DOCMTYPE,
             CFI.TCMM_DOCNO                                                                    AS DOCNO,
             CFI.TCMO_OFFER_SRNO                                                               AS OFFER_SRNO,
             CFI.TCMI_OFFER_SUBSRNO                                                            AS TCMI_OFFER_SUBSRNO,
             CFI.PPRD_PRODCODE                                                                 AS PRODCODE,
             COALESCE(PRDMS.PPRD_DESC, PRDM.PPRD_DESC, PRD.PPRD_DESC)                          AS PRODUCT_DESC,
             CONCAT(OFR.PSCH_SCHME_ID, ' - ', COALESCE(PRMTYPEM.PPMS_DESC, PRMTYPE.PPMS_DESC)) AS PROMOTION,
             CFI.PBTH_BATCH                                                                    AS PBTH_BATCH,
             CONCAT(CFI.PSTT_STOCK_TYPE, '-', COALESCE(STTM.PSTT_DESC, STT.PSTT_DESC))         AS STOCK_TYPE,
             OFR.TCMO_QUALIFIERS                                                               AS TCMO_QUALIFIERS,
             CFI.MODIFIED_DATE                                                                 AS MODIFIED_DATE,

             SUM((coalesce(CFI.TCMI_QTY_1, 0) * coalesce(bth.pbth_uom_factor_1, 0)) +
                 (coalesce(CFI.TCMI_QTY_2, 0) * coalesce(bth.pbth_uom_factor_2, 0)) +
                 (coalesce(CFI.TCMI_QTY_3, 0) * coalesce(bth.pbth_uom_factor_3, 0)))           as FREEQTY,

             SUM((coalesce(CFI.TCMI_QTY_B_1, 0) * coalesce(bth.pbth_uom_factor_1, 0)) +
                 (coalesce(CFI.TCMI_QTY_B_2, 0) * coalesce(bth.pbth_uom_factor_2, 0)) +
                 (coalesce(CFI.TCMI_QTY_B_3, 0) * coalesce(bth.pbth_uom_factor_3, 0)))         as ALLOCATEDQTY


      FROM SND_TR_CMM_CASHMEMO_OFFRITEM CFI
               INNER JOIN SND_TR_CMM_CASHMEMO_OFFERING OFR
                          ON CFI.PORG_ORGACODE = OFR.PORG_ORGACODE
                              AND CFI.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = OFR.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE
                              AND CFI.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE = OFR.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE
                              AND CFI.PDOT_DOCMTYPE = OFR.PDOT_DOCMTYPE
                              AND CFI.TCMM_DOCNO = OFR.TCMM_DOCNO
                              AND CFI.TCMO_OFFER_SRNO = OFR.TCMO_OFFER_SRNO
               LEFT JOIN PRM_PM_PMS_PROMOTION_SETUP PRMTYPE
                         ON OFR.PORG_ORGACODE = PRMTYPE.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND OFR.PSCH_SCHME_ID = PRMTYPE.PPMS_PROMOTION_CODE
               LEFT JOIN PRM_PM_PMS_PROMOTION_SETUP_M PRMTYPEM
                         ON PRMTYPE.PORG_ORGACODE = PRMTYPEM.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND PRMTYPE.PPMS_PROMOTION_CODE = PRMTYPEM.PPMS_PROMOTION_CODE
               INNER JOIN SND_PR_PRD_PRODUCT PRD
                          ON CFI.PORG_ORGACODE = PRD.PORG_ORGACODE
                              AND CFI.PORP_PRINCODE = PRD.PORP_PRINCODE
                              AND CFI.PPRD_PRODCODE = PRD.PPRD_PRODCODE
               LEFT JOIN SND_PR_PRD_PRODUCT_M PRDM
                         ON PRD.PORG_ORGACODE = PRDM.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND PRD.PORP_PRINCODE = PRDM.PORP_PRINCODE
                             AND PRD.PPRD_PRODCODE = PRDM.PPRD_PRODCODE
                             AND PRDM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
               LEFT JOIN SND_PR_PRD_PRODUCT_M PRDMS
                         ON PRD.PORG_ORGACODE = PRDMS.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND PRD.PORP_PRINCODE = PRDMS.PORP_PRINCODE
                             AND PRD.PPRD_PRODCODE = PRDMS.PPRD_PRODCODE
                             AND PRDMS.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCodeSecondary)'
               INNER JOIN SND_PR_TRN_TRANS_NATURE NAT
                          ON CFI.PORG_ORGACODE = NAT.PORG_ORGACODE
                              AND CFI.PTRN_TRAN_NATURE = NAT.PTRN_TRAN_NATURE
                              and nat.ptrn_nature = 'FRE'
               LEFT JOIN SND_PR_BTH_PROD_BATCH BTH
                         ON CFI.PORG_ORGACODE = BTH.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND CFI.PORP_PRINCODE = BTH.PORP_PRINCODE
                             AND CFI.PPRD_PRODCODE = BTH.PPRD_PRODCODE
                             AND CFI.PBTH_BATCH = BTH.PBTH_BATCH
               LEFT JOIN SND_PR_STT_SKU_STOCKTYPE STT
                         ON CFI.PORG_ORGACODE = STT.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND CFI.PSTT_STOCK_TYPE = STT.PSTT_STOCK_TYPE
               LEFT JOIN SND_PR_STT_SKU_STOCKTYPE_M STTM
                         ON STT.PORG_ORGACODE = STTM.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND STT.PSTT_STOCK_TYPE = STTM.PSTT_STOCK_TYPE
                             AND STTM.PLNG_LANGCODE = '@Session(languageCode)'

      GROUP BY CFI.PORG_ORGACODE, CFI.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE, CFI.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE, CFI.PDOT_DOCMTYPE,
               CFI.TCMM_DOCNO,
               CFI.TCMO_OFFER_SRNO, CFI.TCMI_OFFER_SUBSRNO,
               PRDMS.PPRD_DESC, PRDM.PPRD_DESC, PRD.PPRD_DESC, OFR.PSCH_SCHME_ID, PRMTYPEM.PPMS_DESC, PRMTYPE.PPMS_DESC,
               CFI.PSTT_STOCK_TYPE, STTM.PSTT_DESC, STT.PSTT_DESC, OFR.TCMO_QUALIFIERS) AA

                                and cd.pdot_docmtype = cm.pdot_docmtype
                                and cd.tcmm_docno = cm.tcmm_docno
                inner join snd_pr_dot_documenttype dt
                    on
                                cm.porg_orgacode = dt.porg_orgacode
                                and cm.pdot_docmtype = dt.pdot_docmtype

                inner join snd_pr_dot_documenttype dtcm
                    on
                                cm.porg_orgacode = dtcm.porg_orgacode
                                and cm.pdot_docmtype_ref = dtcm.pdot_docmtype
                                and dtcm.pdot_nature_identifier = 'CM'
                inner join snd_pr_prd_product prd on
                                cd.porg_orgacode = prd.porg_orgacode
